description: Implement Phase 1 core marketplace screens: Landing page (app/page.tsx with hero, category grid from GET /categories, featured products from GET /products?limit=8, how-it-works, trust stats, seller CTA), Marketplace grid (app/marketplace/page.tsx with product cards from GET /products with filter params, Sidebar filters, search, sort, pagination), Product detail (app/products/[slug]/page.tsx from GET /products/slug/:slug with image gallery, add-to-cart integration, seller info, reviews section), Cart page (app/cart/page.tsx from GET /cart with quantity controls, remove items, promo code input, order summary, checkout button), Auth screens (app/auth/login/page.tsx with email/password form calling POST /auth/login, app/auth/register/page.tsx multi-step form calling POST /auth/register). All screens must be fully responsive (375px/768px/1440px) and integrate with Zustand stores.
steps: Create frontend/app/page.tsx: Hero section (full-width bg image, H1 'Connect with Ethiopian Farmers', search bar with category dropdown, 2 CTAs Browse/Sell), Category grid (fetch GET /categories, render 2x3 grid on mobile, 3x2 tablet, 6x1 desktop with icons and product counts), Featured products section (fetch GET /products?limit=8&featured=true, horizontal scroll mobile, 2x4 grid desktop, ProductCard component), How It Works (3 steps with Heroicons: MagnifyingGlassIcon/ShoppingCartIcon/TruckIcon + titles/descriptions), Trust indicators (4 stat cards: 10k+ Products, 500+ Farmers, 50k+ Buyers, 14 Regions), Seller CTA (full-width bg section with benefits list, 'Start Selling' button), Footer component

Create frontend/components/ProductCard.tsx: reusable card (4:3 image, name H4, price text-accent font-bold, unit text-textSecondary text-sm, location badge with MapPinIcon, rating stars + count, Add to Cart button visible on hover desktop/always mobile), onClick navigates to /products/:slug, Add to Cart calls cartStore.addItem()

Create frontend/app/marketplace/page.tsx: two-column layout (Sidebar filters left 1/4 width desktop/full-width-drawer mobile, ProductGrid right 3/4), fetch GET /products with query params ?category=&minPrice=&maxPrice=&region=&minRating=&page=&limit=12, search input (debounced), sort dropdown (Newest/Price Low/Price High/Rating), product grid 1 col mobile, 2 col tablet, 3 col desktop, Pagination at bottom

Wire up frontend/components/layout/Sidebar.tsx filters: Categories from GET /categories (checkbox list), Price range (two number inputs min/max), Region (Select dropdown with Ethiopian regions), Rating (1-5 star radio buttons), In Stock (toggle switch), Apply button triggers refetch with new params, Clear button resets filters

Create frontend/app/products/[slug]/page.tsx: fetch GET /products/slug/:slug, left column image gallery (main image + 4 thumbnails, click to switch), right column (breadcrumb Home > Category > Product, name H2, rating stars + review count, price text-3xl font-bold text-accent, unit, description, seller card with avatar/business name/location/verified badge/rating, quantity selector number input with +/- buttons, Add to Cart primary button calls cartApi.add + cartStore.syncWithBackend, Add to Wishlist outline button), below fold: tabs (Description full text, Reviews list, Seller info), Related products section (GET /products/:id/related, horizontal scroll of 4 ProductCards)

Create frontend/components/ReviewList.tsx: fetch GET /products/:productId/reviews, render each review (avatar, name, rating stars, verified purchase badge, date, title, comment, helpful count with thumbs up button, seller response if exists), pagination, empty state if no reviews

Create frontend/app/cart/page.tsx: fetch GET /cart via cartStore, if empty show EmptyState with 'Browse Products' button, else render list (each item: product image, name, price, quantity selector with +/- calling cartStore.updateItem, subtotal, Remove button calling cartStore.removeItem), right sidebar order summary card (Subtotal, Delivery estimate, Discount input with Apply button, Total, Checkout button navigates to /checkout if cart valid else show validation errors)

Create frontend/app/auth/login/page.tsx: center card, H2 'Welcome Back', email Input with validation, password Input with show/hide toggle, Remember me checkbox, primary Login button, links (Forgot password to /auth/forgot-password, Don't have account to /auth/register), on submit call authApi.login(email, password), on success save token via authStore.login() and redirect to redirect query param or /dashboard

Create frontend/app/auth/register/page.tsx: multi-step form (Step 1: Account type radio buttons Buyer/Seller, Step 2: firstName, lastName, email, phone, password, confirmPassword with validation, Step 3: Seller-only fields businessName/location/description, Step 4: Success message with 'Check your email to verify'), use react-hook-form + zod validation, on submit POST /auth/register, show verification required message
acceptance_criteria: Landing page (/) renders with hero, 6 category cards from backend, 8 featured products, how-it-works, stats, seller CTA, footer
Marketplace (/marketplace) shows product grid with working filters (category checkboxes, price range, region, rating), search input, sort dropdown, pagination navigating pages
Product detail (/products/:slug) displays full product info, image gallery, quantity selector, Add to Cart button that adds item to cart and updates Header cart count badge
Cart page (/cart) lists cart items from backend with quantity controls, remove buttons, order summary with subtotal/delivery/total, Checkout button
Login page (/auth/login) has email/password form, on submit calls POST /auth/login, saves token and user to authStore and localStorage, redirects to /dashboard
Register page (/auth/register) has multi-step form, validates all fields, on submit calls POST /auth/register, shows email verification required message
All pages are responsive at 375px, 768px, 1440px breakpoints
Header cart icon badge updates when items added to cart
Header user menu shows Login/Register when unauthenticated, Dashboard/Logout when authenticated
verification: Landing page: verify categories render from GET /categories, featured products from GET /products (check Network tab), click category navigates to /marketplace?category=:slug, click product card navigates to /products/:slug

Marketplace: select category filter -> URL updates with ?category=, products refetch, change price range -> refetch, search 'coffee' -> debounced refetch, sort by Price Low -> products reorder, paginate to page 2 -> URL updates with ?page=2

Product detail: open /products/:slug, click thumbnail switches main image, change quantity to 3, click Add to Cart -> POST /cart/items called (check Network), Header cart badge updates to 3, click Add to Wishlist -> POST /wishlist/items

Cart: open /cart, verify items from GET /cart, click + on quantity -> PATCH /cart/items/:id, cart subtotal updates, click Remove -> DELETE /cart/items/:id, item disappears, cart empty -> EmptyState shows

Login: open /auth/login, submit email/password -> POST /auth/login (check Network), on success -> authStore.user populated, localStorage.accessToken set, redirect to /dashboard, Header shows user menu with name
Register: open /auth/register, step through form, select Seller -> businessName field appears, submit -> POST /auth/register, success message shows
Responsive: test at 375px (mobile), 768px (tablet), 1440px (desktop) breakpoints in Chrome DevTools
